### Are You Scared of Loving Zacchaeus?
Author: Laura MacCorkle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/are-you-scared-of-loving-zacchaeus-crosswalk-the-devotional-march-31-2011.html
Passage: Luke 19:5
Points:
- Society despised and avoided Zacchaeus because of his corrupt profession as a chief tax collector.
- Instead of shunning or condemning him, Jesus sought him out by name and offered personal fellowship.
- Being welcomed by Christ moved Zacchaeus to immediate repentance and generous restitution.
- Christians are called to overcome fear and actively approach people who feel unlovable or different.
- Walking toward the outcasts in our lives reflects the heart of the Great Commission.

### How Do I Respond to Jesus?
Author: Jodi Harris
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-december-5-2023.html
Passage: Luke 19:6
Points:
- Zacchaeus overcame fear and shame to welcome Jesus with eager excitement and joy.
- Experiencing Christ’s personal acceptance transformed his heart and freed him from greed.
- His joyful surrender contrasts with the rich ruler who walked away clinging to his wealth.
- Christians often hesitate to approach God due to lingering guilt or self-reliant pride.
- Believers are invited to run to Christ with open hands, trusting in His welcoming love.
